children: Airbus is close to a provisional deal to buy five Airbus A350-900 jets, industry sources said.
On Thursday, French President Emmanuel Macron said France and Vietnam were nearing completion of another deal for three NH90 helicopters from Airbus Helicopters.
Airbus Helicopters has its roots in a Franco-German merger prompted by the development of the Tiger attack helicopter.
